summary: First iteration full-stack test of DannyZCars Marketplace. Backend: 29/29 pytest cases passed (auth/login + cookie + Bearer, listings CRUD + filters, categories, public messages, admin threads + reply + delete, upload (jpg/png + 5MB reject + non-image reject), file serving, admin stats, 401/403 guards). Frontend: home (hero + 3 sections with seeded cards), navbar search to /browse, browse filtering, listing detail (gallery, WhatsApp button, contact dialog -> internal message creates thread with success toast), unauth /admin redirects to /admin/login, admin login works, admin dashboard shows correct stats (8/8/1/0) and 8 listings table, /admin/new form loads, /admin/messages shows thread list. No blocking bugs.

minor.issue: Admin-only endpoints return 401 (not 403) when authenticated user is not admin. Current code uses get_current_user dependency only; non-admin case not exercised because only admin user exists, but require_admin returns 403 correctly.
No brute-force lockout implemented (playbook recommends 5-attempt lockout). Repeated wrong passwords always return 401 with no rate limit/lock.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby / DialogDescription (console accessibility warning).
Row action icons (toggle-active, edit, delete) have no data-testid attributes; only title attributes (Pausar/Activar). Hard to target reliably in automation.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid to row actions in AdminDashboard listings table: toggle-active-{id}, edit-{id}, delete-{id}.
(Optional) Add DialogDescription to contact dialog in ListingDetail.jsx to silence Radix a11y warning.
(Optional/hardening) Add brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login per playbook (5 fails -> temp lock).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORS allow_origins='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec (browsers reject credentialed wildcard). Works here because token is also in localStorage, but cross-origin cookie auth from real browsers may fail when CORS_ORIGINS is left as '*'. Consider setting explicit origin(s).
server.py: seed admin is idempotent (re-hashes only if current password fails verify). Good.
server.py: file upload writes a stub doc to db.files but file deletion endpoint is missing — orphan files accumulate. Minor.
server.py uses '_id' exclusion (good). All datetimes stored as ISO strings (good).
frontend stores JWT in localStorage AND uses httpOnly cookie; ensure backend keeps cookie path/secure attrs for production domain.
seed_data_creation: None created (used existing 8 seeded listings). Test thread + uploaded file may remain (test cleanup deletes the thread and the test listing, but uploaded test image not deleted).
